about.title: About
about.tagline: Free, ad-free, open-source DNS changer and speed test
about.desc: Finds the fastest, most reliable free DNS, applies it in one click and goes back to the old setting if something breaks.
about.copied: System info copied to the clipboard
about.features_b:
• Tests {n} free DNS providers over plain DNS, DoH and DoT
• Applies the fastest in one click and backs up the old setting
• Lets you add your own DNS address
• Turkish, English and German, light and dark theme
about.privacy_b: No account, no ads, no data collection. Your settings and list stay on this computer. Tests only send queries to the DNS servers you choose.
about.license_b: MIT license: use, inspect, change and share it for free. The software is provided as is, without warranty.
about.disclaimer: The DNS providers named are trademarks of their owners; DNS Hub is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Changing DNS only helps against domain-based blocks.
